mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 4% in the month prior to the decision is associated with a near-term negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to expectations of tighter policy and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the 30-day prior period (p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS > 4.0 months.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 6.5% for two consecutive months, labor market slack increases, boosting consumer demand and driving positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns under the trigger condition are not significantly higher than the 30-day average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in GDPC1 (goods orders) and HOUST (housing starts) above their 12-month moving averages predicts stronger aggregate demand, resulting in positive S&P 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically significant vs. the 12-month pre-trigger average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) of at least 2% for three consecutive months indicates supply-side weakness, which is associated with negative S&P 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < INDPRO_prev_month for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during the trigger are not negative (i.e., ≥ 0) with p < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 218.0 for the first time in a 3-month window, the expectation of persistent inflation prompts a 5-day S&P 500 forward sell-off as investors anticipate rate hikes.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 218.0 in the current month and prior two months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in PAYEMS (employment) above 200,000 for two consecutive months signals labor market strength, which is associated with positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns under the trigger are not significantly higher than the 30-day average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in RSAFS (retail sales) and HOUST (housing starts) by more than 10% in the prior month indicate weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during the trigger are not statistically negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of falling UNRATE (< 7%) and rising FEDFUNDS (> 3%), the interaction between labor market slack and tighter policy is associated with negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns under the trigger are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
